name: @investscape/economic-engine
description: Economic data engines (E29-E45) for InvestScape. Provides regional macro context, city market analysis, neighborhood demographics, comps, and predictive models.

scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:umd
scripts.build:esm: tsc --project tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}, null, 2))" && node scripts/fix-esm-extensions.mjs
